Article 3 (Amendment to the Enforcement Rules of the Civil Special Act on the Implementation of the Agreement on Facilities, Areas, and the Status of U.S. Military Forces in the Republic of Korea under Article 4 of the Mutual Defense Treaty between the Republic of Korea and the United States of America)
The Enforcement Rules of the Civil Special Act on the Implementation of the Agreement on Facilities, Areas, and the Status of U.S. Military Forces in the Republic of Korea under Article 4 of the Mutual Defense Treaty between the Republic of Korea and the United States of America are partially amended as follows.
Attached Forms Nos. 1 and 2 shall be replaced by Attachments 100 and 101, respectively.

Articles 4 through 6 are omitted in the source.

ADDENDUM
These Rules shall enter into force on March 30, 2017.

[Collective Amendment]

◇ Reasons for Amendment and Main Contents

The Personal Information Protection Act was amended (Act No. 14107, promulgated on March 29, 2016 and entering into force on March 30, 2017) to minimize the possibility of infringements of privacy resulting from the collection of personal information by administrative agencies by restricting the legal basis for processing unique identifying information to higher-level legislation. Accordingly, six ordinances under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Justice, including the Enforcement Rules of the State Compensation Act, are to be revised together to replace resident registration numbers, which constitute unique identifying information among the particulars entered in the forms, with dates of birth, and otherwise improve and supplement the format, contents, paper materials and other aspects of the forms according to their purposes.

<Provided by the Ministry of Justice>
